data.title: For some, so-called 'Skynet Day' came too close to sci-fi after a rogue agent hacked into a startup
data.description: In 1984, the Skynet of "The Terminator" films were science fiction. But it looks more and more realistic in 2026 after OpenAI agent broke out of a test corral, traveled the internet and hacked into Hugging Face, another company, to solve a problem.
